_comment: Per-role model map for the Deep Research Tool. Edit a value to override the default, then restart the server (in-app 'Restart Server' or POST /api/restart) to apply. Roles: extract = per-page extraction + category classify; search = browser agent loop + Stage-1 baseline sweep; route = relevance filters, stop-judge, gap-queries; plan = the upfront research planner; synthesize = the cited report (the deliverable). Per user directive all roles run claude-fable-5 at high effort (effort is set in engines/research/llm.py, env override DRT_EFFORT).
